description: Accept or reject pending suggestions (from list_suggestions) in one update. Each one is resolved on its own, exactly as clicking the check or the cross in Docs: accept keeps the proposed change, reject restores the original. Two suggestions that touch each other (by different people) are decided one at a time, and the text comes out as Docs makes it; to decide them together, pass both. A style-only suggestion resolves like any other. expectTitle is checked against the live document first (status "wrong_doc" on a mismatch, e.g. an id from a different, similarly-titled document), and each expectContext is checked against the live suggestion (status "error" on a mismatch or an id that is gone); nothing is changed unless all match. Pass the `title` and each suggestion’s `context` from list_suggestions, verbatim.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

expectTitle.description: the document’s title, from list_suggestions; checked before anything is changed

page.description: which header/footer, when a doc defines more than one (default-page, first-page, even-page). Omit to use whichever exists.

path.description: The doc or tab: a Drive id or URL, /folder/doc, or /folder/doc/tab (nested: /folder/doc/tab/child). A doc with one tab needs no tab step; a doc with several is refused until one is named, and the refusal lists every tab path.

resolutions.description: one entry per suggestion to resolve

segment.description: which content tree to target: body (default), or the page header/footer. Header/footer content is invisible to a body read — a letterhead logo lives there.

name: apply_suggestions
title: Accept/reject one or more suggestions
